<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Update a timeless account.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/v1/timeless-indices/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Updates the name, volume and authorized accounts of a timeless account, and returns the updated timeless account. Send all three fields: the request replaces the current values.

Renaming a timeless account also renames its log type. Optimizers keep writing with the log type they were created with, and [data deletion](https://api-docs.logz.io/docs/logz/delete-timeless-account-data) only matches documents with the current log type, so update the `logType` of every optimizer that writes into the account after a rename.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
